name: Dalaran Mana Gem
summary: Near Ambermill, Kirin Tor mages carry Dalaran Mana Gems to renew their arcane power. Forsaken tailors use the gems to weave enchanted robes.

sections.title: Stolen Arcana
sections.body: The Kirin Tor’s conjurors and guards carry the gems as well. In the Undercity’s Magic Quarter, Forsaken practitioners prize the gems as a ready store of concentrated magic. Some undead mages share an academic heritage with Dalaran. Yet survival comes first, and the Forsaken see the Kirin Tor as rivals whose stores of magic can be taken.

sections.title: Weaving the Spellfire
sections.body: Forsaken bring mana gems taken from fallen Kirin Tor operatives to tailors such as Josef Gregorian in the Undercity. They bring simple linen as well. A tailor cannot channel arcane power directly, but can bind a gem into cloth. The magic strengthens the wearer’s connection to the arcane.

faq.q: Where do Dalaran Mana Gems come from?
faq.answer: Kirin Tor forces carry Dalaran Mana Gems in Silverpine Forest, especially near their encampments and outposts around Ambermill, southeast of the Sepulcher.

faq.q: What are these gems used for?
aliases: why do i need dalaran mana gems
faq.answer: Forsaken mages bring the gems with linen to Josef Gregorian in the Undercity. He uses them to weave spellfire robes.

faq.q: Why are the Kirin Tor in Silverpine carrying these gems?
aliases: why do dalaran wizards have gems
faq.answer: Kirin Tor members carry mana gems as personal stores of arcane power. The gems sustain their spellcasting, defense wards, and conjurations in hostile Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken target Dalaran mages for these gems?
faq.answer: Forsaken and Dalaran share an academic heritage, but the Forsaken see their living counterparts as rivals. Undercity mentors believe a mage who cannot defend their arcane wealth is too weak to survive. So they take the mage’s components.

angles.text: As a Forsaken mage, you are sent to take these gems as a rite of passage. You prove your martial skill and mastery of harvested arcane power.
As an undead traveler, you know the Forsaken set aside sentiment for their former human colleagues in Dalaran to support their faction’s survival.
